issues.title: Missing Verifies clauses for Phases 07-21
issues.why: While AC-10 covers Phases 01-06 with explicit Verifies, AC-12 and AC-13 list invariants for the remaining phases but lack the 'Verifies:' line required by the authoring guide for automated trace-map binding.
issues.fix: Add 'Verifies: the architectural-invariant contract for spec/18 phases NN-NN' to AC-12 and AC-13.

issues.title: Broken internal sub-file references in Overview
issues.why: The File Inventory in 00-overview.md links to 02-enums-and-coding-style/ as a subfolder, but the actual files (01-enum-architecture.md, etc.) are referenced in 02-enums-and-coding-style/00-overview.md without ensuring the parent overview can resolve them.
issues.fix: Ensure all relative links in 00-overview.md use the full path including subdirectories.

issues.title: Partial Concurrency Coverage
issues.why: AC-11 addresses FileLogger and Self-update concurrency but misses Micro-ORM/Database race conditions (e.g., incrementing counters or status transitions) which are common in WP plugins.
issues.fix: Add a row to AC-11 table for 'Database Writes' requiring $wpdb->prepare and atomic SQL updates.
